Source Monster

Monster: Adolescent Rajang | CR: 8 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

While attuned to this weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to your spell save DC when casting spells that deal lightning or thunder damage.

Armor Effect

While you are wearing this armor, you can use your reaction or bonus action to gain resistance to lightning damage until the end of your next turn. You can use this property twice, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.

Tags: mechanic:spell-buff:save, mechanic:reaction, mechanic:bonus-action, mechanic:resistance, damage:lightning, mechanic:long-rest, type:defensive
